Our Pivot to Technology Provider For years, 1EOR successfully operated as a direct global Employer of Record (EOR) provider, helping international businesses hire, pay, and manage remote workers. Through this process, we identified a critical bottleneck: EOR companies and global payroll agencies struggle to provide rapid, accurate statutory cost estimations and contractor audits to their prospects. In 2026, we made the strategic decision to pivot. We packaged our battle-tested global compliance calculators, statutory database connectors, and policy calendar tools into an embeddable B2B SaaS platform. Today, 1EOR does not compete as an EOR; we empower other EOR businesses, HR tech providers, and global recruiters by giving them the technical infrastructure they need to scale sales and support. # Hilario Creative — Fractional Marketing for B2B SaaS

[](https://www.hilariocreative.com/)

[Home](https://www.hilariocreative.com/)[What We Do](https://www.hilariocreative.com/#services)[How We Work](https://www.hilariocreative.com/#how-we-work)[FAQ](https://www.hilariocreative.com/#faq)[About](https://www.hilariocreative.com/about)[Book a Call](https://www.hilariocreative.com/#contact)

About Us
# We started Hilario because great products deserve better marketing.

Our Story
Hilario was built for B2B SaaS companies that have outgrown their current marketing but are not ready for a full in-house team. We have worked with founders, sales leaders, and operators across Canada and the United States, helping them build the positioning, content, and sales materials that close more deals.

The Team

![Image 1: Hamed Jafari](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/hamed-jafari-headshot-_57igni4.avif)

Hamed Jafari

Partner and Marketing Strategist

Hamed has spent over a decade working with tech founders and operators across North America and internationally. He co-founded TechRasa, a leading startup media and market research company, where he interviewed dozens of founders, worked closely with their teams, and built a deep understanding of how fast-growing companies tell their story, find their market, and scale.

That experience—sitting inside many companies and understanding their buyers, their positioning, and their gaps—is the foundation of how Hilario works.

Hamed’s work has been featured in Forbes, Bloomberg, HuffPost, PBS, and PRI.

* * *

![Image 2: Zeynab Abdolghaffari](https://www.hilariocreative.com/assets/zeynab-abdolghaffari-headshot-BhlXskD1.avif)

Zeynab Abdolghaffari

Partner and Creative Director

Zeynab has led design for tech companies across North America, building visual identities and creative systems that work across digital and print. She brings structure and consistency to every engagement, from brand assets to sales collateral to web design.

Because Zeynab works alongside the marketing strategy from day one, what your buyers see is always consistent. The website, the deck, and the LinkedIn post all tell the same story.

Our Network
Depending on the scope of an engagement, we bring in specialists from our network across North America. People we have worked with, trust, and have delivered results with before. You get the depth of a full team with the consistency of working directly with the people who lead the work.

Avoid these mistakes See 8 most common mistakes decision makers are making while looking for a web development company for their next digital product. Article What is a Tech Stack? All you need to know Ever wondered what a tech stack is or what the latest stack technology means for product development? Choosing the right technology and methods will determine if your digital product is safe, scalable and easy to develop. In this article, we’ll answer the question “What is a tech stack?” and tell you about the tech stack we use at Boldare. Article Refining the backlog and the Definition of Ready In Scrum, everything revolves around the sprint, a clearly-defined, intensely productive period of time in which the team tackles priorities from the product backlog. But how does the Scrum team (including the product owner) know when those priorities are ready to be addressed? How do you know when it’s time to sprint? This is where the process of backlog refinement, filtered through what’s known as the Definition of Ready (DoR), plays an essential role. Learn how our collaboration aims to meet specific programming and timeline needs, fostering long-term partnerships. Share this article: Search for an article Table of contents Starting to work with a new client is always a cause for celebration. That’s why we are thrilled to announce the arrival of our new client based in the United States, MAXIO . MAXIO is a financial operation platform designed to assist B2B SaaS companies by streamlining their financial operations. It automates tasks such as billing, subscription management, collections, and reporting. MAXIO came to us thanks to a satisfied Boldare employee, who wholeheartedly recommended us to his contacts. The client had very specific needs regarding programming languages and project timelines. Thanks to our team augmentation service, we were able to meet these requirements and support the company in achieving its business goals. We believe that delivering quality work is just the beginning of a long-term partnership and relationship that we deeply value. We look forward to nurturing this relationship for our mutual benefit. Share this article: Related Articles Article Hiring a web development company? Avoid these mistakes See 8 most common mistakes decision makers are making while looking for a web development company for their next digital product. Article What is a Tech Stack? All you need to know Ever wondered what a tech stack is or what the latest stack technology means for product development? Choosing the right technology and methods will determine if your digital product is safe, scalable and easy to develop. In this article, we’ll answer the question “What is a tech stack?” and tell you about the tech stack we use at Boldare. Article Refining the backlog and the Definition of Ready In Scrum, everything revolves around the sprint, a clearly-defined, intensely productive period of time in which the team tackles priorities from the product backlog. But how does the Scrum team (including the product owner) know when those priorities are ready to be addressed? How do you know when it’s time to sprint? This is where the process of backlog refinement, filtered through what’s known as the Definition of Ready (DoR), plays an essential role. Clearly, the Definition of Ready and the refinement process are interdependent. Refinement results in product backlog items that are ready for development, and the Definition of Ready is the criteria by which we can say that refinement has been successful – if a Definition of Ready is at all unclear, you need to revisit the refinement process! Daktela connects to your e-commerce system and uses AI to automate routine questions (order tracking, returns, delivery details). #### REVENUE

## E-Commerce

Give guests an easy way to discover and buy tickets, experiences, F&B, merchandise or upgrades from their phone,  
 whether they’re planning ahead or deciding what they want next while already inside the venue.

[Book a Demo](http://vantage.co/request-a-demo/ "Request A Demo")

### MORE WAYS TO SPEND

## Create More Opportunities to Add to the Day

**For guests:** Easily discover, purchase and add to their experience without having to visit a service desk.

**For operators:** Capture more revenue, promote add-ons and make it easier for guests to spend without adding more work for frontline teams.

[Video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IEVTe0JE6dg)

![Image 4](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/4-1.png)

### Connected Commerce

## Keep the Opportunity to Purchase Open

Respond to Demand in Real Time

Keep what guests see aligned with what’s actually available. Update inventory, availability and offerings as demand changes throughout the day, helping your team promote what you have capacity for and capture more revenue from available experiences and products.

Make Your Offers More Relevant

Use what you know about each guest to surface more relevant products, upgrades and experiences. Personalized recommendations create natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell while helping guests discover additions that make sense for their visit.

Increase Convenience to Increase Spend

Give guests an easy way to browse and purchase tickets, upgrades, experiences, F&B and merchandise directly from their phone. They can add to their day whenever the opportunity arises, without finding a service desk, joining another line or interrupting what they’re already doing.

### How It Works

## Sell Beyond the Initial Booking

### Guests Browse

Guests explore upgrades, F&B, and other add-ons directly from their phones, reducing reliance on frontline teams to manage upgrades and additional purchases.

### Up-to-Date Inventory

What guests see can reflect availability, inventory and where they are in their visit, keeping purchase options relevant to the moment.

### Personalize the Experience

Surface relevant products and add-ons based on guest information and activity, creating more natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell.

### Guest Purchases

Guests can buy or upgrade directly from their device without visiting a service desk or interrupting their day.

### One Guest Profile

Transactions become part of the connected guest profile, giving operators a clearer picture of how each guest spends and engages.

### Adjust Store

Use purchasing and guest behaviour to understand what’s working, adjust offerings and create more relevant opportunities throughout the rest of the visit.

#### REVENUE

## E-Commerce

Give guests an easy way to discover and buy tickets, experiences, F&B, merchandise or upgrades from their phone,  
 whether they’re planning ahead or deciding what they want next while already inside the venue.

[Book a Demo](http://vantage.co/request-a-demo/ "Request A Demo")

### MORE WAYS TO SPEND

## Create More Opportunities to Add to the Day

**For guests:** Easily discover, purchase and add to their experience without having to visit a service desk.

**For operators:** Capture more revenue, promote add-ons and make it easier for guests to spend without adding more work for frontline teams.

[Video 1](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IEVTe0JE6dg)

![Image 4](https://vantage.co/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/4-1.png)

### Connected Commerce

## Keep the Opportunity to Purchase Open

Respond to Demand in Real Time

Keep what guests see aligned with what’s actually available. Update inventory, availability and offerings as demand changes throughout the day, helping your team promote what you have capacity for and capture more revenue from available experiences and products.

Make Your Offers More Relevant

Use what you know about each guest to surface more relevant products, upgrades and experiences. Personalized recommendations create natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell while helping guests discover additions that make sense for their visit.

Increase Convenience to Increase Spend

Give guests an easy way to browse and purchase tickets, upgrades, experiences, F&B and merchandise directly from their phone. They can add to their day whenever the opportunity arises, without finding a service desk, joining another line or interrupting what they’re already doing.

### How It Works

## Sell Beyond the Initial Booking

### Guests Browse

Guests explore upgrades, F&B, and other add-ons directly from their phones, reducing reliance on frontline teams to manage upgrades and additional purchases.

### Up-to-Date Inventory

What guests see can reflect availability, inventory and where they are in their visit, keeping purchase options relevant to the moment.

### Personalize the Experience

Surface relevant products and add-ons based on guest information and activity, creating more natural opportunities to upsell and cross-sell.

### Guest Purchases

Guests can buy or upgrade directly from their device without visiting a service desk or interrupting their day.

### One Guest Profile

Transactions become part of the connected guest profile, giving operators a clearer picture of how each guest spends and engages.

### Adjust Store

Use purchasing and guest behaviour to understand what’s working, adjust offerings and create more relevant opportunities throughout the rest of the visit.

About DistyMan E-Commerce, Graphic Design & Marketing for Electronic Component Companies Since 2005, DistyMan has helped electronic and electrical component manufacturers and distributors improve how they present, manage, market and sell technical products. We combine e-commerce technology, graphic design, technical content and digital marketing in one industry-focused team. Electronic & Electrical Component E-Commerce Website & Responsive Design Catalog, Datasheet & Graphic Design Technical Content & Product Data SEO, AEO & GEO Optimization Digital Marketing & Advertising Book a Demo Contact Us WHO WE ARE Built Around the Electronic & Electrical Component Industry DistyMan is a design, development and marketing company focused on the
      electronic and electrical component industry. We work with manufacturers,
      distributors and related technical organizations that need to manage complex
      product information, communicate technical value and reach engineers, buyers
      and purchasing teams online. Our capabilities span e-commerce, graphic design, technical content,
      product data, SEO and digital marketing , allowing clients to work
      with one team across the complete digital and print marketing process. OUR HISTORY From Creative Agency to Complete Digital Commerce Partner DistyMan began in 2005 as a marketing and creative agency supporting technical
      companies with websites, product catalogs, advertising, specification libraries
      and other sales and marketing materials. As manufacturers and distributors moved more of their product information and
      sales processes online, our work expanded into product databases, custom web
      development, B2B e-commerce , technical search and system integration. That experience led to the development of DistyMan's proprietary e-commerce
      technology while preserving the graphic design, technical content and marketing
      capabilities that were part of the company from the beginning. Today, DistyMan can support an electronic or electrical component company from
      initial brand and website design through product data, e-commerce, technical
      content, SEO and ongoing digital marketing. WHAT WE DO Three Disciplines Working as One Electronic component companies often need design, technology and marketing
        services at the same time. DistyMan combines all three instead of treating
        them as separate projects. E-Commerce Design, develop and manage e-commerce websites built around large technical
          catalogs, manufacturers, part numbers, specifications and complex B2B requirements. B2B e-commerce B2C / retail e-commerce Unified commerce Marketplace development ERP and API integrations Graphic Design Create professional visual communications that make technical products
          easier to understand, compare, select and promote. Website design Catalogs & selection guides Datasheet design Technical infographics Advertising & brand materials Marketing Increase product visibility and reach engineers, buyers, distributors
          and customers through coordinated digital marketing. SEO, AEO & GEO Google Ads & remarketing Press release marketing Email & social campaigns Technical article development E-COMMERCE E-Commerce Designed for Technical Product Catalogs Electronic and electrical component e-commerce is different from conventional
      retail. Customers may search by exact manufacturer part number, specification,
      package, voltage, current, frequency, product family or application. DistyMan designs and develops e-commerce systems around these requirements,
      including large catalogs, parametric search, customer-specific pricing, RFQs,
      inventory feeds, ERP integration and technical documentation. Product Data Organize manufacturers, part numbers, categories, attributes, images and technical documents. Product Search Support keyword, part-number, parametric, cross-reference and technical product discovery. B2B Commerce Support customer pricing, RFQs, purchase orders, approvals and account-specific workflows. Integrations Connect ERP, CRM, PIM, inventory, supplier, distributor and marketplace systems. GRAPHIC DESIGN Design That Makes Complex Products Easier to Understand Technical products require more than attractive graphics. Designers must
      understand specifications, product families, applications and how engineers
      evaluate competing components. DistyMan combines technical industry knowledge with professional graphic
      design to create visual materials that support product selection, sales and
      brand consistency across digital and print channels. Web Design Responsive websites and product interfaces designed for technical catalogs and e-commerce. Catalogs & Guides Print and digital catalogs that organize products, specifications and selection information. Datasheets Professional layouts for specifications, drawings, features and application information. Marketing Creative Advertising, infographics, email graphics, presentations and product-launch materials. CONTENT + PRODUCT DATA Turn Engineering Information Into Useful Sales Content Product specifications alone do not always explain why a component is useful,

### Why is tailored contact center software critical for e-commerce?

In e-commerce, outstanding customer service is a decisive success factor. Customers expect fast, precise answers and smooth problem resolution, whether they are asking about a delayed shipment, a return, or an order mix-up. Our software gives you the tools to exceed those expectations, even when call volume spikes by 200% or more during Black Friday, Cyber Monday, and the holiday rush. Together, we deliver value such as:

*   **Seamless handled calls:** Guarantee that your customers get support whenever they need it, without long hold times, even during your highest-traffic shopping days.
*   **Cost advantage:** Automated processes and smarter use of resources deliver a significant operating cost advantage, without the need to over-hire seasonal staff.
*   **Smart IVR systems:** Use behavioral science and data analytics to design IVR scripts tailored to your customers' needs and to boost their satisfaction, whether they are calling about order status, returns, or shipping updates.

With ServiceOcean's software, your e-commerce business offers customers real alternatives to waiting on hold for the first time. **Management, customers, and employees are impressed alike!**

### Frequently asked questions

- [x]  How can e-commerce companies increase handled calls in customer service? 

Software solutions like ServiceOcean let online retailers manage high call volumes efficiently and offer customers targeted callback times during peak hours. OBI uses SO Callback and achieves 95% handled calls even during seasonal peaks like BFCM and the holiday season.

- [x]  What tools help with order and return inquiries by phone? 

Tools like SO Callback offer automated callback booking, prioritized call distribution, and smart capacity management, ensuring reliable service even during high demand. Handled calls improve significantly, even during peak periods.

- [x]  How can customer service be automated in e-commerce? 

Customers choose a callback time online. Employees are prepared in advance and can resolve requests faster and more precisely.

Book a Strategy Call → INDUSTRIES Build a Predictable Growth Engine for Your SaaS Connected GTM, Pipeline and Revenue Operations for Technology Companies Book a Strategy Call → Explore Solutions → Building a strong product is only one part of scaling a SaaS or technology company. Sustainable growth also requires clear positioning, a focused ideal customer profile, consistent pipeline generation and connected revenue operations. ScaleurBiz helps B2B SaaS and technology teams turn product potential into a coordinated growth system. We connect go-to-market strategy, outbound execution, RevOps, content and automation around the commercial outcomes that matter to your business. From Product Potential to Predictable Revenue Technology markets move quickly, but growth becomes difficult when messaging, customer acquisition, CRM data and internal workflows operate separately. We help identify the gaps affecting performance and build practical systems connecting marketing activity, sales conversations and revenue visibility. Whether you are preparing to launch, validating a new market, building a sales-led motion or improving an established revenue engine, ScaleurBiz provides flexible strategy and execution support around your stage of growth. SaaS and Technology Businesses We Support B2B SaaS companies AI and automation platforms Cloud, data and cybersecurity businesses Developer tools and software products Technology-enabled service companies IT and managed technology providers Early-stage startups and growing technology teams Established software companies entering new markets SaaS Growth Services Go-to-Market Strategy: Market research, ideal customer profiling, positioning, offer development, channel planning and market-entry support. B2B Lead Generation: Target account research, contact discovery, data enrichment and qualified prospect development. Sales Development and Outreach: Cold email, LinkedIn prospecting, follow-up workflows, qualification and appointment setting. Pipeline Acceleration: Campaign coordination, lead routing, sales handoffs and opportunity-development support. Revenue Operations: CRM structure, lifecycle stages, workflow automation, data quality, reporting and sales and marketing alignment. Content and Conversion: Website messaging, landing pages, SEO content, case studies, email sequences and sales enablement materials. Creative Media and Video: Product visuals, explainer content, social media assets, demos and short-form video editing. AI and Business Automation: Workflow planning, repetitive-task optimization, system connections and internal process automation. SaaS Growth Challenges We Help Address An unclear ideal customer profile or market position Strong product capability but inconsistent qualified pipeline Messaging that focuses on features instead of customer outcomes Long sales cycles with weak follow-up and handoff processes Fragmented CRM data and limited revenue visibility Disconnected marketing, sales and customer success workflows Insufficient capacity for content and campaign execution Manual processes slowing down a growing team Expansion into the USA, UK or Canadian market Build a Stronger RevOps Foundation As a SaaS company grows, disconnected data and inconsistent processes create unnecessary friction. A structured RevOps foundation helps teams understand where opportunities come from, how they move through the pipeline and which activities contribute to revenue. ScaleurBiz can help organize CRM architecture, lifecycle definitions, lead routing, workflow automation, reporting and cross-functional handoffs. The result is a more connected system for managing prospects, opportunities and revenue activity. Focus on the Metrics That Matter Every SaaS business has different priorities, but useful performance indicators may include qualified pipeline, opportunity conversion, sales cycle length, customer acquisition cost, recurring revenue, retention and pipeline velocity. We align reporting and execution with the metrics relevant to your model instead of optimizing activity without a clear commercial purpose. Our SaaS Growth Process Assess: Review your product, market, audience, existing pipeline and revenue systems. Define: Clarify your ideal customers, positioning, offer, priorities and measurable objectives. Build: Create the campaigns, content, CRM workflows and operational foundations required for execution. Execute: Launch approved outreach, content and revenue operations initiatives through organized delivery. Optimize: Review performance, identify friction and continuously improve the growth system. Scale Across the USA, UK and Canada ScaleurBiz supports SaaS and technology companies operating in or expanding across the USA, United Kingdom and Canada. Our approach considers regional buyer expectations, competitive positioning, business communication and operational readiness while maintaining a consistent product identity. Connect your strategy, pipeline and revenue operations with a ScaleurBiz growth system built to help your technology company scale beyond borders. ## FAQs

### Can we choose the level of expertise we need?

Yes. You can deploy highly skilled network specialists for design and complex work, or practical on-site engineers for installations and changes, or a mix of both. This allows you to match skills to the task, rather than paying for over-qualified resource where it isn’t needed.

### How quickly can you get engineers to site?

Response times depend on location, scope and urgency, but our nationwide coverage allows us to mobilise quickly across the UK. Urgent break-fix issues, planned installations and scheduled rollouts are all supported through clearly defined service levels.

### Is this more cost-effective than hiring in-house engineers?

For many organisations, yes. Using UK Connect reduces the need for permanent recruitment, training, travel, idle time and specialist overheads. You get access to the skills you need, when you need them, without carrying long-term employment costs.

### Do you provide nationwide coverage?

Yes. We deliver consistent engineering standards across the UK, allowing you to support regional or national estates without managing multiple local suppliers

### How do you ensure consistent quality across different sites?

All work is clearly scoped, engineers are matched to the task, and delivery follows consistent standards nationwide. Full documentation, including photos and sign-off where required, provides visibility and assurance across every visit.

### Can you support live and operational environments?

Absolutely. We regularly work in live sites where safety, uptime and compliance are critical, including construction sites, warehouses, manufacturing environments and public-facing venues.

### Do you work alongside our internal teams or other contractors?

Yes. We frequently collaborate with in-house IT teams, facilities teams, principal contractors and third parties. Our role flexes to fit your operating model, providing support where it adds the most value.

### Is this suitable for short-term projects as well as long-term programmes?

Yes. We support ad-hoc site visits, defined projects and ongoing programmes. You can scale usage up or down as requirements change.

### How is pricing structured?

Pricing is transparent and clearly scoped based on the work required, location and skill level needed. There are no hidden costs, and you only pay for the services you use.

### How do we get started?

It begins with a short conversation to understand your sites, challenges and priorities. From there, we’ll recommend the right mix of Field Services and Network & Professional Services to support your organisation.

## FAQs

### Can we choose the level of expertise we need?

Yes. You can deploy highly skilled network specialists for design and complex work, or practical on-site engineers for installations and changes, or a mix of both. This allows you to match skills to the task, rather than paying for over-qualified resource where it isn’t needed.

### How quickly can you get engineers to site?

Response times depend on location, scope and urgency, but our nationwide coverage allows us to mobilise quickly across the UK. Urgent break-fix issues, planned installations and scheduled rollouts are all supported through clearly defined service levels.

### Is this more cost-effective than hiring in-house engineers?

For many organisations, yes. Using UK Connect reduces the need for permanent recruitment, training, travel, idle time and specialist overheads. You get access to the skills you need, when you need them, without carrying long-term employment costs.

### Do you provide nationwide coverage?

Yes. We deliver consistent engineering standards across the UK, allowing you to support regional or national estates without managing multiple local suppliers

### How do you ensure consistent quality across different sites?

All work is clearly scoped, engineers are matched to the task, and delivery follows consistent standards nationwide. Full documentation, including photos and sign-off where required, provides visibility and assurance across every visit.

### Can you support live and operational environments?

Absolutely. We regularly work in live sites where safety, uptime and compliance are critical, including construction sites, warehouses, manufacturing environments and public-facing venues.

### Do you work alongside our internal teams or other contractors?

Yes. We frequently collaborate with in-house IT teams, facilities teams, principal contractors and third parties. Our role flexes to fit your operating model, providing support where it adds the most value.

### Is this suitable for short-term projects as well as long-term programmes?

Yes. We support ad-hoc site visits, defined projects and ongoing programmes. You can scale usage up or down as requirements change.

### How is pricing structured?

Pricing is transparent and clearly scoped based on the work required, location and skill level needed. There are no hidden costs, and you only pay for the services you use.

### How do we get started?

It begins with a short conversation to understand your sites, challenges and priorities. From there, we’ll recommend the right mix of Field Services and Network & Professional Services to support your organisation.

# Flexible workspace, designed for professional services

From secure offices and soundproofed rooms to Access Plans for project teams and virtual receptionist support, Spaces offers a tailored workspace platform for professional services. Designed for focus, client trust, and operational efficiency — wherever business takes you.

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)[(845) 484-1588](tel:(845) 484-1588)

![Image 2: Spaces Professional Services](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_20,w_420,h_257,g_auto:subject//v1756990835/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_5.jpg)

*   ## Work without compromise

Confidential, enclosed offices and meeting rooms — ideal for environments where privacy is key.  
*   ## Impress your clients

Professional reception, polished spaces, and tech-ready rooms for every meeting.  
*   ## Present in key hubs

Be where your clients are — from London’s legal district to Midtown Manhattan.  
*   ## Support that understands your needs

Live receptionists, virtual office services, and a team that understands your professional workflow.

## Built for how professional firms really work

Win trust from the first handshake. Our client-ready private offices, bookable meeting rooms, and quiet focus spaces make every consultation smooth. Scale desks for project teams, host workshops on demand, and work from premium addresses across our network — confidential, flexible, impeccably serviced.

## Confidentiality and control, by design

For firms where privacy is paramount, Spaces delivers fully enclosed offices and sound-insulated meeting rooms — with secure access, professional staff, and infrastructure built to protect sensitive work. Whether you're reviewing contracts, holding depositions, or preparing client strategy, you’ll have the space to focus.

*   Lockable private offices and firm-dedicated suites
*   Soundproofed rooms for confidential calls and client meetings
*   On-site printing, shredding, and secure document handling and storage
*   Reliable, high-speed connectivity and private network options

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)

![Image 9: Spaces Professional Services Confidentiality And Control By Design](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_auto,w_668,h_343,g_faces//v1755815632/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_6.jpg)

## Client-ready spaces that uphold your reputation

You’re often meeting clients at critical moments — closings, consultations, or negotiations. Spaces provides polished boardrooms, discreet breakout areas, and professional welcome services that reflect your standards and elevate the client experience.

*   Elegant meeting rooms, boardrooms, and interview spaces
*   Professional front-of-house teams to greet clients
*   Rooms equipped for hybrid meetings, presentations, and signing sessions
*   Booking by the hour, day, or on a recurring basis

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)

![Image 10: Spaces Professional Services Client Ready Spaces That Uphold Your Reputation](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_auto,w_668,h_343,g_faces//v1755815599/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_7.jpg)

## Be present in global legal and advisory hubs

From legal corridors to financial capitals, Spaces offers prime office and meeting room locations in the cities that matter most to professional firms. Work from our offices in Midtown Manhattan, London’s Holborn and City districts, Frankfurt’s Bankenviertel, or Singapore’s Marina Bay — with consistent quality and support across the network.

*   Over 4,000 locations globally, with offices in key legal and consulting centers
*   Project teams can enjoy on-demand access to private offices, coworking spaces, or meeting rooms
*   Virtual office presence in strategic regulatory jurisdictions
*   Work-ready setups in cities in close proximity to your clients and cases

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)

![Image 11: Spaces Professional Services Be Present In Global Legal And Advisory Hubs](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_auto,w_668,h_343,g_faces//v1756990461/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_8.jpg)

## Services that work for you

Professional services firms have specific operational needs — and we’ve designed solutions to match. Whether you’re registering a subsidiary, expanding into a new jurisdiction, or setting up virtual receptionist support, our team helps you stay focused on the work that matters.

*   Company registration support across international markets
*   Live call answering in your firm’s name, with custom scripts and call routing
*   Mail handling, forwarding, and virtual address services
*   Scalable office IT with secure connectivity and on-site support

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)

# Flexible workspace, designed for professional services

From secure offices and soundproofed rooms to Access Plans for project teams and virtual receptionist support, Spaces offers a tailored workspace platform for professional services. Designed for focus, client trust, and operational efficiency — wherever business takes you.

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)[(845) 484-1588](tel:(845) 484-1588)

![Image 2: Spaces Professional Services](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_20,w_420,h_257,g_auto:subject//v1756990835/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_5.jpg)

*   ## Work without compromise

Confidential, enclosed offices and meeting rooms — ideal for environments where privacy is key.  
*   ## Impress your clients

Professional reception, polished spaces, and tech-ready rooms for every meeting.  
*   ## Present in key hubs

Be where your clients are — from London’s legal district to Midtown Manhattan.  
*   ## Support that understands your needs

Live receptionists, virtual office services, and a team that understands your professional workflow.  

![Image 3: logo](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fit,f_auto,q_auto,w_134,h_64//v1756204604/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/deloitte.png)![Image 4: logo](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fit,f_auto,q_auto,w_134,h_64//v1756204607/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/pwc.png)![Image 5: logo](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fit,f_auto,q_auto,w_134,h_64//v1756204604/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/ey.png)![Image 6: logo](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fit,f_auto,q_auto,w_134,h_64//v1756204605/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/kpmg.png)![Image 7: logo](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fit,f_auto,q_auto,w_134,h_64//v1756204606/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/mckinsey.png)![Image 8: logo](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fit,f_auto,q_auto,w_134,h_64//v1756204608/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/bcg.png)

## Built for how professional firms really work

Win trust from the first handshake. Our client-ready private offices, bookable meeting rooms, and quiet focus spaces make every consultation smooth. Scale desks for project teams, host workshops on demand, and work from premium addresses across our network — confidential, flexible, impeccably serviced.

## Confidentiality and control, by design

For firms where privacy is paramount, Spaces delivers fully enclosed offices and sound-insulated meeting rooms — with secure access, professional staff, and infrastructure built to protect sensitive work. Whether you're reviewing contracts, holding depositions, or preparing client strategy, you’ll have the space to focus.

*   Lockable private offices and firm-dedicated suites
*   Soundproofed rooms for confidential calls and client meetings
*   On-site printing, shredding, and secure document handling and storage
*   Reliable, high-speed connectivity and private network options

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)

![Image 9: Spaces Professional Services Confidentiality And Control By Design](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_auto,w_668,h_343,g_faces//v1755815632/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_6.jpg)

## Client-ready spaces that uphold your reputation

You’re often meeting clients at critical moments — closings, consultations, or negotiations. Spaces provides polished boardrooms, discreet breakout areas, and professional welcome services that reflect your standards and elevate the client experience.

*   Elegant meeting rooms, boardrooms, and interview spaces
*   Professional front-of-house teams to greet clients
*   Rooms equipped for hybrid meetings, presentations, and signing sessions
*   Booking by the hour, day, or on a recurring basis

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)

![Image 10: Spaces Professional Services Client Ready Spaces That Uphold Your Reputation](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_auto,w_668,h_343,g_faces//v1755815599/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_7.jpg)

## Be present in global legal and advisory hubs

From legal corridors to financial capitals, Spaces offers prime office and meeting room locations in the cities that matter most to professional firms. Work from our offices in Midtown Manhattan, London’s Holborn and City districts, Frankfurt’s Bankenviertel, or Singapore’s Marina Bay — with consistent quality and support across the network.

*   Over 4,000 locations globally, with offices in key legal and consulting centers
*   Project teams can enjoy on-demand access to private offices, coworking spaces, or meeting rooms
*   Virtual office presence in strategic regulatory jurisdictions
*   Work-ready setups in cities in close proximity to your clients and cases

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)

![Image 11: Spaces Professional Services Be Present In Global Legal And Advisory Hubs](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_auto,w_668,h_343,g_faces//v1756990461/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_8.jpg)

## Services that work for you

Professional services firms have specific operational needs — and we’ve designed solutions to match. Whether you’re registering a subsidiary, expanding into a new jurisdiction, or setting up virtual receptionist support, our team helps you stay focused on the work that matters.

*   Company registration support across international markets
*   Live call answering in your firm’s name, with custom scripts and call routing
*   Mail handling, forwarding, and virtual address services
*   Scalable office IT with secure connectivity and on-site support

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)

![Image 12: Spaces Professional Services Services That Work For You](https://assets.iwgplc.com/image/upload/c_fill,f_auto,q_auto,w_668,h_343,g_faces//v1755815576/WebsiteImagery/Gallery/PS_9.jpg)

## Need help finding the perfect workspace?

Our dedicated workspace experts are here to help. Connect today and let’s find the ideal solution for your business.

[Contact us](https://www.spacesworks.com/en/contact-form#industry=Professional+services)[(845) 484-1588](tel:(845) 484-1588)

More ways to sell through the marketplace with professional services | Microsoft Community Hub Open Side Menu Skip to content Tech Community Community Hubs Products Topics Blogs Events Skills Hub Community Register Sign In Microsoft Community Hub Communities Topics Microsoft Partner Community Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program Marketplace blog Blog Post Marketplace blog 3 MIN READ More ways to sell through the marketplace with professional services justinroyal Microsoft Sep 11, 2024 Cloud marketplaces continue to increase in popularity as the preferred way for organizations to find, try, and buy software—especially as cloud and AI needs continue to become more complex. The Microsoft commercial marketplace is central to how we sell alongside you, our partners, to help you reach more customers, simplify sales, and unlock growth. To support you with more ways to service your customers, Microsoft now empowers partners in Canada, the United Kingdom, and the United States to sell professional services through private offers in the marketplace. For software development companies, you often need to account for a variety of services to support your product sales. Whether that’s assisting with implementation, training your customers, or providing support over the long-term, the value of your teams’ time and resources can be accounted for directly within your marketplace sales with professional services for private offers. And, for other partners like systems integrators, managed service providers, etc., they can provide professional services (through a private offer) to support their customers who prefer the simplicity of purchasing through the marketplace. Watch this demo video to learn more about unlocking growth by selling professional services. The value for you and your customers As customers shift to marketplaces to centralize their cloud portfolio, they can further simplify purchasing by streamlining software and services purchases through one platform. Customers can get your solutions while buying directly from Microsoft, and have purchases consolidated directly on their Azure invoice. As a partner, you can skip the hassle of vendor onboarding while dramatically simplifying your sales—while reaching a global market. Plus, by bundling your software and service, you decrease time-to-value for your customer. “Now that professional services are offered within the Microsoft commercial marketplace, it gives us another path to service our customers with simplified selling. And we can bundle our service and product together, helping our customers cut through procurement red tape.” - TeamViewer How it works For partners in eligible geographies, you can now: sell your professional services as a standalone private offer or attach your professional services to a private offer alongside your software. Examples of professional services include: assessments, briefings, customer support, implementation, migration, proof of concepts, and workshops. These professional services are sold as private offers. You can inform your customer that the private offer is ready directly from Partner Center when you build the offer. The customer th e n receives an email that directs them to the Azure portal. Assuming they have proper permissions, the customer will accept and purchase the professional services private offer. With the private offer, you can also negotiate your terms and use flat-rate billing plans including upfront, monthly, or annual payments for up to three years Any company who is part of the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program can sell professional services. Details are provided in our documentation, but at a high-level: Be a member of the Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program (it’s free to join) Sign the marketplace publisher agreement Publish your offer Sell professional services private offers Get started with marketplace The Microsoft commercial marketplace is dedicated to helping you reach more customers, simplify sales, and unlock growth. If you’re building an application and looking to maximize marketplace success, consider joining ISV Success. Partners who join get access to free benefits, designed to help you build across the Microsoft Cloud, publish faster, and grow your partnership opportunity. Get details on how to join in the ISV Hub . To get started selling professional services, check out the technical documentation . This category of services encompasses many sectors, including legal, accounting, consulting, research and development, architecture and engineering, and advertising. U.S. exports in professional and business services reached $189 billion in 2019. Imports totaled $76 billion. Most U.S. trade in professional and business services is with Europe, which received 55 percent of U.S. exports in this industry in 2019.  About half of U.S. professional and business services imports came from Europe. The Asia-Pacific region attracted close to one-fourth of U.S. exports and accounted for 31 percent of U.S. imports. Employment and Wages In 2019, over 9.3 million people worked in the professional and business services industry in the United States. Roughly 23 percent of those jobs were in the computer systems design and related services sector, which leads the industry in employment. Architecture and engineering and consulting services each employed 16 percent of individuals in this industry. These jobs may be either full-time or part-time. The average annual wage across all professional and business services is relatively high at $85,720. The mean annual wage for each sector within this industry, as defined by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, exceeded the average for all occupations of $53,490 in 2019. The bottom line is that U.S. jobs in professional services generally offer a very competitive wage compared with other sectors of the economy. Access the full data for all of these charts . × Global Business Navigator Chatbot Beta Welcome to the Global Business Navigator, an artificial intelligence (AI) Chatbot from the International Trade Administration (ITA). This tool, currently in beta version testing, is designed to provide general information on the exporting process and the resources available to assist new and experienced U.S. exporters. The Chatbot, developed using Microsoft’s Azure AI services, is trained on ITA’s export-related content and aims to quickly get users the information they need. The Chatbot is intended to make the benefits of exporting more accessible by understanding non-expert language, idiomatic expressions, and foreign languages. Limitations As a beta product, the Chatbot is currently being tested and its responses may occasionally produce inaccurate or incomplete information. The Chatbot is trained to decline out of scope or inappropriate requests. The Chatbot’s knowledge is limited to the public information on the Export Solutions web pages of Trade.gov, which covers a wide range of topics on exporting. While it cannot provide responses specific to a company’s product or a specific foreign market, its reference pages will guide you to other relevant government resources and market research. Always double-check the Chatbot’s responses using the provided references or by visiting the Export Solutions web pages on Trade.gov. Do not use its responses as legal or professional advice. Inaccurate advice from the Chatbot would not be a defense to violating any export rules or regulations. Privacy The Chatbot does not collect information about users and does not use the contents of users’ chat history to learn new information. All feedback is anonymous. Please do not enter personally identifiable information (PII), sensitive, or proprietary information into the Chatbot. Your conversations will not be connected to other interactions or accounts with ITA. Conversations with the Chatbot may be reviewed to help ITA improve the tool and address harmful, illegal, or otherwise inappropriate questions. Translation The Chatbot supports a wide range of languages. Because the Chatbot is trained in English and responses are translated, you should verify the translation. For example, the Chatbot may have difficulty with acronyms, abbreviations, and nuances in a language other than English.
